data.subject: Farming Simulator Newsletter – October 2026
data.preview: Beans & Alpacas is here! Discover free content updates, watch NewsHarvest and get ready for the Modding Contest. View this email in your browser Hey farmers,

View this email in your browser (https://example.com/7531af362d04acd1a51dcc02daad25b1894d287e8539279be8026fc05e159f7d4ca)

Hey farmers,

Beans & Alpacas has arrived! Explore the new Catuaí map, grow bananas and coffee, meet fluffy alpacas, and discover new machines and production chains in Farming Simulator 25.
But that's not all!

Catch up on the latest NewsHarvest episode, enjoy new updates for Farming Simulator 25 and Farming Simulator 26, and get ready for the upcoming Modding Contest!
https://example.com/50f0d9a3


** New Expansion Available!
------------------------------------------------------------
Welcome to Catuaí! The Beans & Alpacas Expansion for Farming Simulator 25 takes you to a new region inspired by rural Brazil. Build your coffee estate, grow bananas, and care for alpacas and Brahman cattle. With more than 25 new machines, new production chains and construction projects, plus more placeables than ever, there are plenty of ways to make this tropical farming adventure your own. Watch the launch trailer and start exploring!

👉 Launch Trailer (https://example.com/50f0d9a3)


** There's More To Discover!
------------------------------------------------------------

Want to take a closer look? Explore the new region and find out more about its crops, animals, machines and farming opportunities on our blog:

Get it Now! (https://example.com/8e9836adc120735191f0e036ac7a03d1b52bcf2c9e7ff4fb6e68c3a)
https://example.com/4194f71e


** NewsHarvest: Halloween Episode!
------------------------------------------------------------

Things are getting spooky in NewsHarvest! In our Halloween episode, we cover a game we cancelled (sort of). Curious what that's all about? Watch the episode and find out! We also have answers to your questions about a Year 3 Season Pass, future content updates, FarmCon and more!
Watch Now (https://example.com/4194f71e)
https://example.com/5d95f6f18dc0883f8374a55de


** Patch 1.25: A Helping Hand!
------------------------------------------------------------

A little help goes a long way! Patch 1.25 for FS25 lets you hire helpers to ride and groom your horses. There's also construction progress in the HUD, improved vehicle displays and various fixes round out the update. Improvements for the Highlands Fishing Expansion, Straw Harvest Pack, Pumps n' Hoses Pack and Emergency Pack are included as well.

👉 Patch Notes (https://example.com/5d95f6f18dc0883f8374a55de)
https://example.com/8a22cd508bdae466b2fdba1882c472356093c320e26f9


** More Free Machines for FS25 & FS26
------------------------------------------------------------
Missed our recent free content updates? There are more machines waiting for you! Free Content Update #7 for Farming Simulator 25 adds the Merlo EW 25.5, SOLÀ Velox 300/12 planter, SOLÀ AURA 2000 seed tank and Škoda Fabia, introducing SOLÀ to the series for the first time.
More Info (FS25) (https://example.com/d2574b8444a87f935b481437881441555b6937476)

For Farming Simulator 26, Free Content Update #2 brings the Lode King Renown Drop Deck, Mercedes-Benz MB-trac 1800 Turbo and Unimog U 535. Make sure your game is up to date and put these additions to work, completely free of charge!
More Info (FS26) (https://example.com/4000a696be013b782a33c370d39b1fcdb964081ed)
https://example.com/ce9d0d8ed224b0b4a6f7904db8480ef941d8ad3bf


** Get Ready for the Modding Contest!
------------------------------------------------------------

Got a great idea for a mod? Now's the time to bring it to life! Our Farming Simulator 25 Modding Contest offers a prize pool worth over €30,000 across four categories: Best Mod, Best Map, Best Crossplay Mod and Volvo Future Construction Machines. Submissions open on November 16, 2026, and close on January 15, 2027. Check the rules, start creating and show the community what you've got!

More Contest Info 🏆 (https://example.com/ce9d0d8ed224b0b4a6f7904db8480ef941d8ad3bf)
Until the next newsletter,
Your GIANTS Software Team
